summary: Chunk 1 of 7.5 (49 units): 24 issues (1 error, 23 minor), 24 with machine patches; no regrouping suggested. One real error: unit 27 dropped the second vā (either...or). Otherwise the draft is faithful: all tokens and splits parse, grams checked, ca/hi/tu/api/eva rendered, no Latin or brackets in Hindi, no added वह/पुरुष/लोग. Fixes are Hindi/English alignment (unit 19, 20, 25, 30, 37, 38, 42), literal senses instead of interpretive ones (2, 9, 33, 34, 36, 47, 48) and small grammar/label points (10, 12, 26). Drafter doubts: text_flags in 12 (opening quote missing, units 9-11 are Kautilya so the flag stands), 45 (stray dash, keep) and 46 (viśvas tasya = viśvastasya, confirmed by the 8+8 metre) are all right; yātavya 'the one to be marched against' and kalatra 'household' accepted; sattra stays untranslated; ca...ca 'both...and' accepted in English, Hindi keeps one और. Low confidences are honest; unit 25 could also be low. Not applied: Hindi quote-mark style (single marks for unquoted alternatives in English, double in Hindi units 1, 9, 16, 40, 43) and apacarita (English 'wronged' vs Hindi अपचरित) are left to a person.
